timeline.event: checkout config_v42 deployed with EU tax endpoint mapping change
first tax service failure: region mismatch for eu-order
retry failed: tax endpoint us-east cannot serve eu tax quote
incident detected: EU checkout requests failing with tax calculation errors

root_cause: Misconfigured EU tax endpoint mapping in checkout config_v42 causing region mismatch
why_it_happened: Checkout config_v42 deployment changed EU tax endpoint mapping at 09:14
The new configuration incorrectly routed EU tax requests to us-east endpoint
us-east endpoint could not process EU tax quotes, causing region mismatch errors
ruled_out_hypotheses: Payment gateway outage (payments service was healthy at 09:20)
Database pool exhaustion (errors were region mismatch, not timeout saturation)
immediate_mitigation: Rollback checkout config to last known good version (config_v41)
